name: Infinity FAQ Schema & Accordion
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Infinity FAQ Schema & Accordion allows you to add FAQs quickly and efficiently using a custom post type and repeater meta boxes for unlimited questions and answers. Designed for SEO, speed, and responsiveness, it works seamlessly with any modern WordPress theme.

Key Features

  • ✅ Multiple FAQ templates: Accordion, Toggle, List, Classic, Card
  • ✅ Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • ✅ Custom colors for questions, answers, background, and icons
  • ✅ Built-in live search functionality for easy navigation
  • ✅ Shortcode [infinity_faq] with category filtering
  • ✅ SEO-friendly: automatic FAQPage schema for Google rich results
  • ✅ Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • ✅ Easy to use; no coding required

Usage Examples

  • Show all FAQs: [infinity_faq]
  • Show FAQs from specific categories: [infinity_faq category="support,pricing"]
  • Show limited number of FAQs: [infinity_faq per_page="5"]
  • Show FAQs in a toggle template: [infinity_faq template="toggle"]

Use Cases

  • Support pages
  • Product FAQs for eCommerce stores
  • Knowledge base or documentation pages
  • Service websites
  • Any website needing organized FAQ sections

Support

Visit https://example.com/support for documentation, FAQs, and support.

Additional SEO Notes

  • Uses FAQPage schema automatically for all questions.
  • Fully compatible with Google rich results.
  • Supports multiple templates and custom styling to match site branding.
  • Lightweight code for fast page load and minimal impact on SEO.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the infinity-faq folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Add FAQs using FAQs → Add New.
  4. Insert [infinity_faq] shortcode wherever needed.
sections.faq:
Can I display FAQs on multiple pages?

Yes! Use [infinity_faq] on any page, post, or widget area. You can also filter by categories.

Is Infinity FAQ Schema & Accordion SEO-friendly?

Absolutely! It automatically adds FAQPage structured data compatible with Google Rich Results.

Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Yes! Fully responsive and compatible with modern themes.

Can I customize colors and icons?

Yes, you can customize question color, answer color, background color, and icons in the FAQ options.

Can users search FAQs on the frontend?

Yes! Infinity FAQ Schema & Accordion includes a live search bar to quickly filter questions.
